message:
Thank You Winston, 7/10/85
I smoke, either smoke or don’t smoke, once you start your hooked for good, I wouldn’t think of quitting. I’ve smoked your king size filters for ten years now, after the first pack just start enjoying it, I like the feel of the butt in my lips, and the good taste in my mouth, I enjoy every puff of a rich thick Winston deep in my lungs, especially after a good meal, I like just to relax, suck up your smoke and get social, I don’t feel bad that I smoke it’s a pleasure I deeply enjoy, I’m hooked for good, thanks Winston, for all the fine years of great smoking pleasure.

Faithfully Yours,
Jim R. Wilson
Portland Oregon.
